run.decision: PASS ON FROZEN INTRINSIC VALIDATION GATES / ATM-SVP-3 EVIDENCE WEAK. The externally anchored fixed 2% BTC satellite on 98% frozen V11 produced 15.798526% CAGR, 1.354951 Sharpe and 8.144367% MDD with 7/7 positive-Sharpe folds and all no-leverage/cash constraints satisfied. The matched V11 replay produced 14.720670% CAGR, 1.290286 Sharpe and 7.380963% MDD. Candidate improves CAGR by 1.077856 pp and Sharpe by 0.064665, but MDD is 0.763403 pp higher, therefore the frozen all-three comparison gate FAILS. The 16%/1.45 objective also fails. Global DSR probability is 0.385701944 across 78 performance-bearing candidates, so final validation evidence is WEAK rather than strong PASS. No BTC-weight or timing rescue is permitted; the next allowed work is statistical robustness auditing of this exact frozen candidate.

methodology.follow_up_policy: After formal performance is viewed, do not change BTC weight, add timing, change rebalance cadence or alter V11. If this candidate fails comparison or objective, 1/3/5% BTC variants are forbidden rescue tuning. A genuinely different crypto risk-budget method such as externally specified volatility dilution requires a separate preregistered lineage.

run.title: v11-btc2-satellite-001 / 冻结V11+2%比特币卫星001; externally risk-budgeted permanent crypto satellite on immutable V11 events

strategies.description: Bitcoin is a high-return but high-tail-risk independent asset source. A very small permanent satellite can potentially add secular crypto exposure without allowing crypto to control the portfolio risk regime. Scaling every frozen V11 target weight by exactly 98% and adding exactly 2% BTC only on the original V11 rebalance dates should preserve V11 risk-off behavior and gross<=100% while testing whether a risk-budget-sized crypto sleeve can improve matched-window return without materially degrading Sharpe or drawdown.
